prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Original low-magic medieval pixel-art cast review sheet, THREE ROWS and TWO COLUMNS, six full-body pose studies on plain grey background. Each row a different adult, same identity front-left three-quarter then back-right three-quarter. Top IVE, adult woman descendant of people left outside a siege gate: mature round face, short greying braid, muted brown wool mantle and charcoal dress, holds her OWN small ordinary unlit clay oil lamp with both hands, steady restrained anger, not a grieving stereotype. Middle VIT, retired woman night-watch worker: strong mature woman with short cropped iron-grey hair, weathered face, desaturated green padded work coat and old leather shoulder protection, plain belt pouch CLOSED around local commemorative token, boots, open empty hands, no military medal, sword or official crest. Bottom VIMON, former male night-shift colleague who voluntarily left: lean mature man with tied dark hair streaked grey, plain oatmeal work shirt, faded blue short work vest, brown trousers, rope at belt, relaxed but firm refusal posture; NO award, uniform, medal or hero pose. Separate designs, not a reunion and not any forgiveness ceremony. Story memory is unresolved; no supernatural dead, no medal removal, no signing, no changed allegiance. Appearances are original proposals only. Coarse crisp pixel clusters, readable small top-down-oblique game-sprite silhouettes, restrained earthy palette, simple faces and folds, hard selective dark outlines. Do not draw text, numbers, modern emblems, smooth painting, glossy 3D, gradient glow, environment or border. Concept review only, not runtime-ready animation.
